description: This Java class 'JpaMobileAppDao' implements data access object (DAO) for MobileApp entities, providing methods to find, delete, and retrieve MobileApp data from the database, specifically for mobile applications within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: JpaMobileAppDao
classes.description: DAO class for MobileApp entities, providing methods for database operations related to mobile applications.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO, which is MobileAppEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JpaRepository instance for MobileAppEntity.

methods.name: findByBundleIdAndPlatformType
methods.description: Finds a MobileApp by its bundle ID and platform type (Android or iOS).

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of MobileApps for a specific tenant and platform type, with optional text search.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all MobileApps associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: findByPkgNameAndPlatformType
methods.description: Finds a MobileApp by package name and platform type.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is MOBILE_APP.
